Tikoncha is a modern technology platform aimed at creating a safe digital environment for children and teenagers.

In cooperation with parents, schools and the community, we help children use smartphones and the internet in a moderate, conscious and useful way.
With Tikoncha, your child's digital activity is under control, while trust and respect are preserved.

With our app:
• distracting apps and content are restricted,
• opportunities that serve education and development are supported,
• the child's safety and daily balance are ensured.

Tikoncha is not just a control tool.
It is a step toward shaping digital culture in child-rearing, responsible technology and a healthy future.

We believe:
Technology should serve not to restrict children, but to guide them in the right direction.
